section.11: The Book of the Commencement of the Prayer

11.name_native: The Book of the Commencement of the Prayer

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Anas that:The Prophet (ﷺ), Abu Bakr, and Umar, may Allah be pleased with them both, would start their recitation with: "All the praise and thanks be to Allah, the Lord of all that exists
